descriptionChirho: Inherent power, might, or strength, whether of God, the Spirit, or human agents — the abstract capacity or force itself (singular).
A specific act of supernatural power, a miracle or mighty work viewed as an individual event (singular).
Plural acts of supernatural power — miracles, wonders, and mighty works performed by God or his agents.
Spiritual or cosmic powers — angelic beings, heavenly forces, or supernatural authorities viewed as entities (plural).
The meaning or force of something spoken, i.e. what an utterance signifies (as in 1 Cor 14:11).
Personal ability or capacity to do something, emphasizing practical capability rather than raw force.
